decisions.reason: Changing the arrangement of the existing eight badges to two rows of four does not change the approved badge catalog, count, Legend exclusion, or icon designs.
The badge-row arrangement does not change NFT book-cover rendering; the source message's NFT-size observation is a separate clause and already represented in this Requirement's history.
The badge-grid layout change does not alter referral-validation feedback; the wording adjustment in the same message is an independent decision already represented under this Requirement.
Arranging badges into two rows of four does not change the FAQ explanation of badge purpose or any other FAQ content.
This Requirement governs mobile stacking of landing-page stats and mechanics, while the source decision concerns the separate badge-display grid.
The badge-row arrangement does not modify the landing-page hero structure, visual density, messaging, or control clearance.
Changing how badge icons are arranged does not alter referral milestones, award destination, award basis, or on-chain recording.
The badge-grid layout has no effect on prize eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or winner selection.
The badge-row arrangement does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, cadence, eligibility, or funding rules.
The badge-grid layout does not alter dashboard visibility of referral commissions.
The visual arrangement of badges does not alter dashboard accounting or visibility of prize-ticket counts.
Changing badge display rows does not affect whether badges, book access, referral codes, or prize-ticket state transfer on secondary sale.
